proposal.name: Keep Go helpers out of parent test events

plan.name: Keep Go helpers out of parent test events
plan.summary: Bind the Go event handoff to the launched test process before package initialization using a host-owned exec launcher, and have the testing hook check that ownership before opening or writing the endpoint, so helpers started from dependency init, TestMain or test bodies run ordinary Go testing without changing the parent's lifecycle or losing diagnostics. Use this same launch path for local and prepared-Docker runs, preserving literal arguments, package directory and PWD, exit behavior, invocation binding, protocol validation, shared deadlines and process-tree cleanup; update the existing runtime-start observers to recognize the launcher while retaining their refusal and fresh-execution assertions, and scope docker591Boundary.policy's leak scan to Docker's own options before the image for create/run and before the container for exec, retaining every existing leak check on those options and every other policy assertion unchanged. Acceptance tests compare passing, failing and skipped parent runs with helper-free events and ordinary go test, exercise empty, passing and failing helpers at all three phases, and cover the production Docker transport through its existing daemon-free fixture; TestSandboxBoundsEveryPhaseInsideContainer/acceptance uses the separate built-in runner and must continue passing unchanged with its six-second run budget, 30-second shard limit, five-second completion grace, watchdog, completed-phase records and refusal to accept unfinished execution. Update SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to replace the early-init infrastructure-error limitation with the ownership rule and explain that testing initialization consumes the handoff after checking ownership, even when dependencies have initialized first. This refines D-0327 and rests on D-0321, D-0334 and D-0344; the merger records the new decision, while the changed SPEC bullet cites the already recorded decisions and unavailable real-Docker checks remain merger work.

tests.name: TestGoProducerKeepsHelpersOutOfLifecycle548
tests.says: Helpers re-executed before testing initializes, from TestMain and from a test body preserve ordinary Go exits and diagnostics, leave passing, failing and skipped parent lifecycles identical to helper-free runs, and produce complete parent evidence without infrastructure errors.

tests.name: TestDockerGoProducerKeepsHelpersOutOfLifecycle548
tests.says: The prepared-Docker transport runs the same Go producer with early-init, TestMain and test-body helpers while preserving parent events, separate diagnostic channels, literal arguments, complete evidence and cleanup, without requiring a Docker daemon.

usage.summary: Revised `plan.json` and preserved its acceptance tests, adding the Docker fixture correction while keeping sandbox bounds unchanged. The plan check passed on attempt 1, the sandbox acceptance case passed unchanged, and `repo/` was not modified.
